name: Nyanmel
source:
A cat which [url=/c571]Michiru[/url] found at the ground site of Mihama Academy. Michiru calls it “Neko-nya” and [url=/c567]Yuuji[/url] calls it “Rommel”, so they combine them and the name “Nyanmel” comes out. 

[Edited from Shiori-chan's review]
